resources.string: Already using Shizuku? Start it, then connect and authorize Operit here. Sui users can connect directly below. Switching stops the built-in service; external service startup is managed by its own app.

No Root required. Pair once, then start the built-in service. Boot recovery is enabled automatically and retains pairing authorization. Recovery requires the system to allow wireless debugging on the connected Wi-Fi network. Stopping the service also stops recovery.
Activate the built-in service with Root. Boot recovery is enabled automatically; stopping the service also stops recovery.
Run the command from a connected computer to activate the built-in service. Boot recovery uses wireless debugging afterward; pair this device above first. No separate recovery switch is needed.
